title: A found DiceWare Poem
summary: Lining freeing component labored slackness payer amiable despite atrophy slacker, cruncher irk headlock departure unabashed catapult protecter, Provoker Sponge Poetry #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Lining
freeing component labored slackness payer
amiable despite
atrophy
slacker, cruncher irk
headlock
departure unabashed catapult protecter, Provoker Sponge

Poetry
